status: Two opt-in, default-off analyzer policies benchmarked offline on 23 saved captures. Live reports unchanged; the live server never passes either policy. No calibrated distance and no NEAR/FAR verdict is established.

default_config_reproduction.note: The four differing ranging-v1 trials are stored at analysis_version four-arrival-diagnostic-v1 (current: four-arrival-diagnostic-v2); f60fa320 is a failed stub with no protocol_version. These differences pre-date this work.

headline_changes.caveat: Its single tail has peer delay jitter 6.396 ms and 3/7 recurrence at the tighter 2 ms window; the classification rests on the 10 ms window. The centimeter figure is uncorrected and is not a device-body distance.

synthetic_checks.note: In-memory only, injected into a copy of 20e97c08; nothing saved. Synthetic checks do not validate physical accuracy.
synthetic_checks.source: scratchpad/ws1/synthetic.json (recorded under the pre-rename class name late_tail_source_locked)

cases.tail_10pct: unclassified_secondary (0.05-0.20 band); fatal under both policies
cases.tail_0.3pct: never clears the event threshold; no event produced

limitations: True sample deletion (frames removed rather than zeroed) leaves no silent span and produces no PCM timeline candidate; only the existing clock-step check and worklet counters can notice it, and neither localizes it in the PCM.
Exact silence, a muted source and digital padding produce identical samples; a candidate is an observation with declared thresholds, not an identified cause.
The 10 ms recurrence window is about a chirp-envelope width and does not resolve a fixed delay; on 37fa17db the matched peer offsets span 6.396 ms.
Chirps carry no source authentication: a recurrent weak tail is equally consistent with room/device response and with a schedule-locked co-located replay.
Corroboration by the clock-step check structurally cannot apply where a break follows the first emission (8335587e); absence of corroboration is not evidence against a candidate.

Peak-family selection is unchanged and remains open; on 8335587e the BA path alternates selected-minus-strongest lag between 0 and -13 samples (~0.271 ms) and holds the segment above the 0.15 ms residual gate.
No policy changes a selected arrival, repairs a recording, or produces a NEAR/FAR verdict. No calibrated distance follows.
Segmentation currently recovers exchanges on two trials and validates none.
